items.name: Spare
items.opening: The room held a chair, a window, dust moving through light.

items.name: Lyrical
items.opening: Morning spilled golden across the floorboards like honey through fingers, sweet and irretrievable.

items.name: Wry
items.opening: The cat had knocked over the urn again, which seemed about right for a Tuesday.

items.name: Ominous
items.opening: Something had changed in the house overnight, though nothing appeared moved or broken.

items.name: Warm
items.opening: The kitchen smelled of bread and coffee, familiar as a hand on your shoulder.

items.name: Brisk
items.opening: Rain. Cold. The door stuck. A push fixed it. Inside then, dripping.

items.name: Melancholy
items.opening: The garden had forgotten its purpose, grew wild now with no one to remember.

items.name: Formal
items.opening: The establishment maintained its composure despite the rather unfortunate events of the preceding evening.
